GRR.headline: Widespread soaking rain possible Saturday; showers into Thursday AM

areas.label: Soaking rain, locally 2+ inches
areas.quote:
The global ensemble systems have generally been producing median 
QPF around 1 inch, with about 20 percent reaching 2 inches, 
indicating a widespread soaking rain is likely along with swaths 
of locally more than 2 inches where thunderstorms persist.

areas.label: Showers, isolated thunder
areas.quote:
The chance for occasional showers and perhaps a thunderstorm 
continues into Thursday morning, though the potential for heavy 
rain should likely be contained south of southwest Michigan 
tonight.

areas.label: IFR low clouds overnight
areas.quote:
Conditions this evening will range from IFR across southern Lower
Michigan to MVFR across central Lower Michigan.

areas.label: Small craft conditions, gusts 25 kt
areas.quote:
Small
craft advisory conditions are possible Friday night into Sunday 
as winds strengthen with gusts to 25 knots.

DTX.headline: Widespread showers Saturday may bring 1 inch or more of rain

areas.label: Rainfall over 1 inch possible
areas.quote: Euro ensembles indicate > 70% chance of half an inch or more or rainfall, with 40-60% chance of one inch or more in the Saturday into Saturday night timeframe.

areas.label: Easterly gusts 20-30 kt
areas.quote: A moderate gradient, supporting easterly gusts 20-30kts, lingers behind the low Sunday into the new work week as the area holds between the stalled boundary over the Ohio Valley and high pressure over northern Ontario.

APX.headline: Heavy rain possible Friday night, mainly along/south of M-72

areas.label: Heavy rain, M-72 and south
areas.quote:
Current confidence is in a 
solution that brings a swath of potentially efficient rain into

into early Saturday with additional heavy rain chances thereafter

MQT.headline: Heavy rain likely Friday PM-Saturday AM over southern half of UP

areas.label: 1"+ rain potential, south half UP
areas.quote:
Rain becomes likely (>60% chance) for the south half of the UP 
Friday afternoon into at least Saturday morning, where there is a 
moderate chance (40-60%) of amounts exceeding an inch.

areas.label: NE winds 20-30 kt, 3-4 ft waves
areas.quote:
Friday 
and Saturday, low pressure passing by to the south combined with a 
high to the north will result in prolonged northeasterly flow into 
the western arm of Lake Superior, with winds increasing to 20-30 kt 
and waves of 3-4 feet.
